findings.sourceEvidence: Universities act as an engine room of a modern society. Guide gloss: a place where essential skilled work is produced.
findings.issue: The current outcome requires a backstage team (幕後持續工作的團隊), and nearly every assessed example is a hidden support unit inside a service. The source instead applies the image to universities as whole institutions producing essential work for society. Being backstage is common but is not a necessary condition of this expression. The sole university dialogue reduces the relation to a research centre inside the university, so the source's institution-to-larger-society use is not assessed.
findings.suggestedRepair: Broaden the learning outcome to a productive team or institution, often but not necessarily backstage. Add or revise one assessed case and an aligned EN/ZH model to show an institution's continuing skilled work serving a larger community without copying the guide sentence or implying it alone sets policy. Retain the existing support-team use as a valid variant.
